title: SWIFT: A Handcrafted, Arithmetic-Minimal FPGA Engine for Real-Time Audio Deepfake Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.29315v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative voice cloning threatens voice-based authentication, yet current deepfake detectors rely on power-hungry, high-precision models unsuited to edge hardware. We present SWIFT (Streaming Whiten-Integer Forensic Trust-Engine), a handcrafted detector that works in the high-frequency noise domain where synthesis artifacts concentrate. A first-order integer high-pass residual drives nine families of fixed-point descriptors, among them integer lifting-wavelet cepstral quantiles, Mahalanobis anomaly distances, Poincar\'e phase-space geometry, and phase jitter, fused by calibrated gradient-boosted trees and a sparse L1-regularised meta-learner. Under leakage-controlled nested cross-validation, with one shared preprocessing chain for real and fake audio, this reference model reaches accuracy of up to 99.86% and an Equal Error Rate (EER) as low as 0.03% across eight benchmarks. translated_title: SWIFT：一种手工设计、运算精简的FPGA引擎，用于实时音频深度伪造检测
translated_abstract: 生成式语音克隆技术对基于语音的身份认证构成威胁，然而当前的深度伪造检测器依赖于高功耗、高精度模型，不适合边缘硬件。我们提出了SWIFT（流式白化整数取证信任引擎），这是一种在合成伪影集中的高频噪声域工作的手工设计检测器。一阶整数高通残差驱动九个定点描述子家族，其中包括整数提升小波倒谱分位数、马氏异常距离、庞加莱相空间几何和相位抖动，通过校准的梯度提升树和稀疏L1正则化元学习器进行融合。在泄漏控制的嵌套交叉验证下，对真实和伪造音频使用共享的预处理链，该参考模型在八个基准测试中达到高达99.86%的准确率和低至0.03%的等错误率（EER）。其整数前端和定点线性分类器运行……
tldr: SWIFT是一种运算精简的手工设计FPGA引擎，在高频噪声域中利用九个定点描述子家族融合检测音频深度伪造，在八个基准测试中达到最高99.86%的准确率和低至0.03%的等错误率。
en_tdlr: SWIFT is a handcrafted, arithmetic-minimal FPGA engine that detects audio deepfakes in the high-frequency noise domain by fusing nine families of fixed-point descriptors, achieving up to 99.86% accuracy and an EER as low as 0.03% across eight benchmarks.
